description: Tech compensation for one company and job family from Levels.fyi's public salary page (e.g. google + software-engineer): total-comp, base, stock and bonus percentiles (p10-p90) with sample size, and the average package per level (L3, L4 ...) with typical years of experience. United States figures in USD as published; reflects user-reported data. Choose this tool for: Tech compensation for one company and job family. Close alternatives on this server: jobs_ashby_jobs_board (Open roles from one company's public Ashby job board); jobs_builtin_tech_jobs (Tech and startup jobs from Built In for a search term: job). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
